homeMetadata.title: K Lab
homeMetadata.description: A programmable trust and execution layer for institutional money movement. Built for governments, financial institutions, and private capital. Configurable. Permissioned. Enforceable.

hero.eyebrow: K Lab is the trust infrastructure company behind K Rails.
hero.subtitle: The Infrastructure governments, banks, companies, and private capital use to move regulated money. Every payment verified before it executes. No exceptions.
hero.statYearsBody: Powered by five years of proprietary transaction data & AI models

homeKrails.whatIsBody1: K Rails doesn’t move money. It decides when each payment is authorized, and keeps a record of the entire process.
homeKrails.whatIsBody2: The money moves through the banks and payment systems you already use. K Rails connects to those systems to approve each payment according to defined rules, and record every step permanently and immutably.
homeKrails.replaceBody1: You already run your operations on your own system. K Rails connects to that foundation to add approval rules, full visibility into the payment process, and end-to-end traceability.
homeKrails.replaceBody2: K Rails doesn’t replace anything. It connects to what you already have and adds three that don’t exist today: automatic approval rules, the option of reverse factoring for suppliers who need it, and a record no one can alter.
homeKrails.trustTagline: Built to be trusted. Designed to be simple.
homeKrails.trustBody: Government, banks and auditors all see the exact same real-time data.
homeKrails.trustEncryptBody: Financial data protected by cryptographic standards used by defense agencies.
homeKrails.trustFailureBody: A cyberattack on one server cannot corrupt the ledger. Data is distributed and replicated.
homeKrails.trustPrivacyBody: Each party sees only what they're authorized to see. Vendor data stays private; auditors see the full trail.
homeKrails.trustAuditBody: Every action permanently recorded. Records cannot be retroactively altered by anyone.
homeKrails.rebateTagline: With reverse factoring and programmable payment rails.
homeKrails.rebateBody: Suppliers choose whether to take early payment in exchange for working capital.
homeKrails.rebateStep3Body: Compete daily to fund the reverse factoring capital.
homeKrails.rebateStep4Body: Choose current terms or get paid early / factor at any time.
homeKrails.rebateCompareLeft: Most payables finance platforms only extend your terms.
homeKrails.rebateCompareRight: K Rails also shares the economics back with you — a rebate on every invoice, not just more time to pay.
homeKrails.rebateComparePhoneAlt: K Rails mobile app showing pending invoice approvals
homeKrails.addonsBody: the layer that decides when a payment moves. Three add-ons extend it. Adopt one, or all three.
homeKrails.addonsCallout1: Auto extracts contract data, no need for manual entry.
homeKrails.addonsCallout2: Validates vendor, budget, and terms automatically.
homeKrails.addonsCallout4: Converts contract into a trackable, milestone-based agreement
homeKrails.serveCallout: Enhance audit reporting efficiency and facilitate the timely notification of risk and fraud-related activities through the automation of smart contracts based on predefined rules
homeKrails.serveGovernmentsBody:
Billions sit in payment delays, audit gaps, and duplicate invoices that no one catches until it's too late.

Contracts, approvals, suppliers, invoices, and payment terms become visible and enforceable before money moves. It prevents duplicate payments, supplier fraud, contract manipulation, and misuse of public funds.

Same payment terms. A rebate on every invoice. Fraud blocked before it's paid. Zero capital outlay.
homeKrails.serveEnterprisesBody: Keep existing payment terms, with no change to DPO or working capital. Earn a rebate — a share of the factoring economics posts back to your ledger. Duplicate and fraudulent invoices blocked before payment, with full real-time visibility. Zero capital outlay — a rebate with no balance-sheet impact.
homeKrails.serveSuppliersBody: Factor any approved invoice instantly instead of waiting 30–90 days. Improve working capital and cash-flow predictability. Lower financing cost — verified invoices are cheaper to fund than unsecured credit. Transparent, predictable payment timelines.
homeKrails.serveBanksBody: Invoices are verified on-chain and can't be double-pledged — bank-grade collateral. Lower underwriting risk: obligations are buyer-backed and independently verified. Deploy capital into factoring and earn the spread. Repayment certainty — K Rails routes the buyer's payment straight to the bank.
homeKrails.serveCapitalBody: Deploy capital into a new, short-duration asset class backed by verified, bank-grade invoices. Earn the spread on every invoice funded — without taking on unsecured credit risk. Access deal flow from governments, multinationals, and enterprises, independently verified before funding. Repayment certainty — K Rails routes the buyer's payment straight to the funder.
homeKrails.whyHeadline: Each system in the transaction serves a different function.
homeKrails.whyIntro: Enterprise systems manage the workflow. Payment networks move the money. Banks provide the capital. None of them creates the trusted, finance-ready record that connects all three.
homeKrails.whyOutro: This gap persists for structural reasons: it sits outside each participant's core business, requires data no single institution holds, and would take years and significant capital to replicate. K Lab doesn't replace banks, ERPs, or payment networks — it enables every participant to trust the same transaction.
homeKrails.whyRow1Dont: Doesn't create trusted, finance-ready assets across institutions
homeKrails.whyRow2Dont: Doesn't verify contracts, authorize invoices, or manage end-to-end finance workflows
homeKrails.whyRow3Dont: Doesn't manage enterprise workflows or institutional credit processes
homeKrails.whyRow4Dont: Don't own the workflows or technology to continuously verify and orchestrate every transaction
homeKrails.whyKlabDo: Connects all participants through a programmable trust infrastructure
homeKrails.whyKlabDont: Create the trusted, finance-ready assets every participant can rely on
homeKrails.faqFactoringA: Suppliers get paid early, funded by a bank instead of you. You keep your terms. A share of the savings comes back to you.
homeKrails.faqErpQ: Does K Rails replace my ERP or banking systems?
homeKrails.faqErpA: K Rails doesn't replace anything. It connects to your ERP and banking systems to add approval rules, visibility, and an unalterable record.
homeKrails.faqFundingA: Bank partners on K Rails compete daily to fund reverse factoring. You don’t put up the capital.
homeKrails.faqTermsQ: Does this change my payment terms?
homeKrails.faqTermsA: No. You keep your current payment terms, with no change to DPO or working capital.
homeKrails.faqFraudQ: How are invoices protected from fraud or duplication?
homeKrails.faqFraudA: Duplicate and fraudulent invoices are blocked before payment, with full real-time visibility.
homeKrails.faqStartedQ: How long does it take to get started?
homeKrails.faqStartedA: K Rails plugs into your existing ERP and payment rails. Structured sprints take you from scoping to go-live without disrupting current operations.
homeKrails.ctaTitle: Unlock the savings already inside your invoices.

companyHero.headlineLine1: K Lab is the trust infrastructure company
companyHero.subhead: K Lab is a Miami-based B2B technology company building the trust infrastructure that enables banks to finance enterprise, multinational and government account payables at scale.

companyWhatWeBuilt.title: What We Built
companyWhatWeBuilt.leadParagraph1: By combining a programmable, blockchain-verified trust layer with intelligent transaction orchestration, K Lab enables digital reverse factoring and confirming programs for receivables that have historically been too complex or opaque to finance.
companyWhatWeBuilt.leadParagraph2: K Lab adds a programmable trust layer on top of existing financial systems — banking core, ERPs — verifying participants, automating compliance checks and validating transactions ahead of every transfer while creating a transparent record of every step.
companyWhatWeBuilt.introLine: One core platform. Three modules extend it — adopt one, or the full stack.
companyWhatWeBuilt.moduleRails: The core. Decides whether a payment should move, under what conditions, and through which rail. Compliance and audit, built in.
companyWhatWeBuilt.moduleTalk: Ask questions by text or voice. Get instant answers, summaries and visualizations, pulled from every data source on the platform.
companyWhatWeBuilt.moduleRisk: Real-time credit and risk scoring on financial, tax, bank and bureau data. Continuous monitoring, not one-time underwriting.
companyWhatWeBuilt.moduleLeads: Finds and ranks commercial opportunities, feeding new deal origination.
companyWhatWeBuilt.valueBanks: Banks lend and earn the spread.
companyWhatWeBuilt.valueSuppliers: Suppliers advance invoices for working capital.
companyWhatWeBuilt.valueKLabEarns: K Lab earns a fee in the middle.

journeyTimeline.title: Our Trajectory
journeyTimeline.subtitle: More than five years of intelligence. One programmable platform.
journeyTimeline.paragraph1: K Lab is built on the transaction history, proprietary models and operational data acquired from KEO World — a B2B payments company that processed real transactions across Latin America for more than five years.
journeyTimeline.paragraph2: That earned intelligence is now the foundation of K Rails — a system trained on how institutional money actually moves.

foundation.paragraph: At K Lab, we believe innovation is transformation, but true transformation extends beyond technology; it must include social impact. Our success is designed to be cyclical, flowing back into communities.
foundation.section1: Our commitment to K Lab is dedicated to continuously deploying its innovative tech ecosystem and crafting advanced AI models. A core part of our mission is to pledge a % of revenue directly to K Foundation.

litepapers.label: K LAB LITEPAPER
litepapers.heading: Explore how K Lab reimagines blockchain payments with stability and predictability at its core
litepapers.description: K Lab is a purpose-built, EVM-compatible Layer-1 blockchain advancing the frontier of stablecoin finance and tokenization. It features USDC as native gas, deterministic settlement finality, opt-in privacy, and a stable transaction fee architecture. Optimized for stablecoin-native use cases, such as global payments, FX, and capital markets, K Lab serves as a foundational settlement layer for programmable money on the internet.

krails.whyBlock0Description: For networks, issuers, acquirers, banks, and processors: K Rails inserts an intelligent authorization layer into existing payment infrastructure — enabling dynamic pricing, flexible MDR allocation, faster settlement, real-time transaction visibility, and T+0 settlement logic. No replacement of existing rails required.
krails.whyBlock1Description: Contracts, approvals, vendors, invoices, and payment conditions become visible and enforceable before money moves. Addresses duplicate payments, vendor fraud, contract manipulation, and misuse of public funds. The value is not just efficiency — it is trust, accountability, and defensible proof.
krails.whyBlock2Description: K Rails ingests financial statements, tax data, bank statements, invoices, and credit bureau data to support scoring, credit line recommendations, continuous monitoring, and early warning signals. Not a one-time underwriting event — the system monitors risk continuously and flags changes in real time.
krails.whyBlock3Heading: Private Capital — Portfolio Company Capital Deployment
krails.whyBlock3Description: PE firms, private credit managers, and fund sponsors deploy capital to portfolio companies with no intelligent layer in between. K Rails connects capital managers to every company in the portfolio in real time: automating disbursements, embedding supply chain finance, monitoring risk, and providing a live auditable view of how every dollar is deployed.
krails.ctaSubheading: K Rails has built a programmable control layer for money movement. The strategic value is not faster payments. It is controlled movement of money with embedded governance, dynamic economics, risk intelligence, and defensible proof — configurable by the institution, enforceable at every step, and auditable by design.
krails.codeSectionHowCard0Description: AI interprets ambiguity. Once confirmed, the system compiles into a fixed workflow, rule set, SQL logic, approval sequence, or payment instruction — repeatable, audited, and defended.
krails.codeSectionHowCard1Description: The right person sees the right information at the right time, with a defensible audit trail — giving institutions control without making adoption politically impossible.
krails.codeSectionHowCard2Description: Every payment, disbursement, or credit action passes through a configurable rule engine connecting buyers, suppliers, FIs, networks, ERPs, government systems, and settlement rails into auditable workflows.
krails.codeSectionHowCard3Description: Settlement can occur through any existing rail — ACH, wire, SEPA, card networks, digital wallets, or stablecoin. The platform is the logic layer above the rails, not a replacement.
